items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You had Jon Hendricks and Coltrane. Who were some of the other people in that? [INTERVIEWEE] A big bunch of guys.

ctx.x: It was a big band. “Think you can lick it, get to the wicket, buy your ticket.” I’ll always remember that rap. “New York, New York, a city so nice, they had to name it twice.” That Jon Hendricks is a character.
Jon is, yeah. Now we’re going to see what the – what did they call it? Everything now is this – you know like these ten things they use.
Like what, recording or multi-tracking? What are we . . .? Overdubbing?
